"'''Hammer Eight'''" was a [[clone trooper pilot]] who served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Hammer Squadron (Galactic Republic)|Hammer Squadron]]. During the [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|Battle of Kothlis]], Hammer Eight covered fellow [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Wingnut]] as he flew his damaged [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] back to the ''[[Pioneer]]''.<ref name="Stealth" />
